visualCharacteristics.purpose: Fund allocation chart: tab bar of breakdown views (sectors, regions, largest holdings), each with a chart graphic (e.g. world map with bubbles) and a legend of series with percentages
visualCharacteristics.layout: Tab bar on top, graphic below, centred legend row under the graphic

contentPattern.structure: optional 1-cell intro rows; then one row per view: tab label | graphic (picture, or a table/text) | legend list (one item per series, e.g. '66,4 % Nordamerika')

reuseGuidance: Use fund-chart for fund allocation / breakdown charts. The block renders the authored chart image and legend per view statically; the tabs only switch between authored views. Live fund data, an interactive chart library and any data service are out of scope for now and need a later integration pass.
